subject: spanish
title: Bigger Numbers
final_note: Big numbers for ages and prices.

walkthroughs.body_html: Veinte (20), treinta (30), cuarenta (40), cincuenta (50), sesenta (60), setenta (70), ochenta (80), noventa (90), cien (100). Mostly end in -enta.
21-29 join up: veintiuno, veintidos, veintitres. After 30: 'treinta y uno' (31 — 'thirty and one').
'Tengo 13 anos' = I have 13 years = I'm 13. Use tengo (I have) — same pattern as French.
